messages:
Nora P: Quick travel q for anyone headed to the Barcelona conf: is it worth shipping a small extra suitcase with swag/booth stuff or carry-on only? also any tips for cheap SIMs there?
Julian S: I shipped a small box to the hotel desk last year. arrived same day, cheaper than checking a bag. Hotel will usually hold it for a few days.
Rita G: Bring a portable charger with EU adapter. for sim, get an esim from Airalo before landing 1 cheaper than kiosk queues.
Ethan L: If you're shipping, label with hotel + "Attention: Conference" and include return postage label if you want stuff back.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Company shipping reimbursements require pre-approval. See travel policy: https://intranet/travel (attach invoice to expense).
Nora P: Awesome tips. Poll: react with 4b3 if you prefer ship-to-hotel, 6c8 for carry-on-only, 4e6 if undecided (depends on booth).
Julian S: 4b3
Rita G: 4e6
Ethan L: 6c8 (carry-on unless swag >2kg)
Nora P: Thanks! I'll precheck shipping with ops and drop a short checklist in the event doc.
